Tank versus damage

Attack is only half the story. A Electric Pal with high defense and HP survives longer in tower fights, while a pure attacker clears open-world camps faster. For raids and tower bosses, mix one high-defense Electric Pal into the party so the AI absorbs hits while your damage dealers work. Element matchups matter too — Electric is strong against the elements it counters and weak against its own counters, so check the target before you commit a team.

Frequently asked questions

What is the strongest Electric Pal?

Orserk has the highest base attack among Electric Pals at 130.

How many Electric Pals are there?

26 Pals in the current data have the Electric element.

Which Electric Pal has the most defense?

Azurmane leads with 110 base defense.

Is a monotype Electric team viable?

Yes for most content, but a single element team gets punished by its counter. Bring one off-element Pal for tower fights.
